observations: Photo 0: one tall white plastic single-tub top-loading machine standing on a floor against a blue wall.
Photo 0: a red and black 'NEXUS' logo sticker on the front panel; no model plate, capacity label or control panel visible.
Photo 0: clothes are piled on the lid, so the lid, controls, timer knobs and drum are not shown.
Photo 0: the plastic looks dull and slightly yellowed with marks near the base; it reads as used rather than barely used.
Photo 0: a power cable runs from the top; the machine is not shown running or with water in it.
Only one photo; no back, no inside of the tub, no receipt or warranty card shown.

identity.kind: single tub top load washing machine

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a single-tub top-load machine with a Nexus logo; whether it washes or only spins is not shown because the lid and controls are covered.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No receipt shown; photo 0 shows dull, slightly yellowed plastic and marks near the base, which fits ordinary use.
No clip of the machine filling, washing, spinning or draining.
The back and base screws are not shown, and an untouched casing cannot prove the motor was never repaired.

risks.risk: Motor, timer or drain may not work; the machine is not shown running.
risks.proof: A clip with the lid open showing it filled with water, the agitator turning both ways, then draining, with the timer knob turned on camera.

risks.risk: Capacity and model unknown; it may be the smallest Nexus single-tub unit or a spin-dry-only unit rather than a washer.
risks.proof: A close photo of the rating plate on the back or side showing model number and capacity in kg, plus a photo of the open lid and control panel.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest-capacity Nexus single tub unit

risks.risk: Cracked tub, broken lid or missing hose and power plug under the clothes.
risks.proof: Photos of the empty machine from front, top with lid open, back with hoses, and the plug.
risks.if_unproven: as with damaged lid or tub and missing hoses

risks.risk: Age and purchase claim may be false; it may be several years old.
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt and warranty card next to the machine's rating plate with matching model.
risks.if_unproven: as an older used unit with no warranty

proof_requests: Clip of the machine washing with water and then draining, timer turned on camera.
Close photo of the rating plate showing model and capacity.
Photos with clothes removed: lid open, inside the tub, control knobs, back with hoses and plug.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card beside the machine.
response.reason: The Nexus logo is readable and the kind is clear, so it can be priced as the smallest Nexus single-tub top loader in used, not-working condition. Proof of running, capacity and receipt would raise the price.
